messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: geo-dns anomalies detected — elevated NXDOMAIN + stale A records from multiple resolver POPs (automated)
harper (oncall): getting page. synthetic checks show spikes in dns failures for geodns.redwood.ai starting 02:12 PDT, error 503 at our edge LB. Symptoms: clients in APAC returning cert mismatch (old IPs), EU fine.
rui: seeing an unusual surge in Route53 change propagation logs around 02:10 PDT. There was an automated rollout of a geo-policy tweak from last night. Could be related.
dan: can you paste the change-id? I want to check whether a rollback happened.
rui: change-id C-20260302-0148. It updated weighted routing for SEA -> new pool. TTLs were 300.
harper (oncall): okay, primary hypothesis: Route53 update partially propagated, Cloudflare resolvers in some regions still serving cached old records, causing split-brain resolution and TLS cert mismatch (old ip served cert for legacy host).
amelia: customer-reported symptom: "inference-api timed out, then cert error" from APAC. Support ticket #11234. Will add to impact doc.
karthik: what are health checks saying? Route53 health-check for the new pool returned intermittent fails at 02:11 which could have triggered fallback behavior.
harper (oncall): Ill start mitigation. Steps:
1) pause further Route53 rollouts
2) reduce TTL to 60
3) push a forced geo-dns revert to the last-known-good config
4) purge Cloudflare resolver cache where possible
5) open tickets with AWS and Cloudflare

Ill hand off steps to dan and rui.
dan: running rollback: /infra dns rollback --change-id C-20260302-0148
deploy-bot: command accepted: /infra dns rollback --change-id C-20260302-0148 by dan
rui: rolling TTL change now: update Route53 TTL for geodns records -> 60
deploy-bot: Route53 update queued. TTL set to 60 for geodns records.
dan: rollback completed, publishing propagation log entry.
rootcause-bot: Note: Route53 change C-20260302-0148 -> ROLLBACK executed. Delta: weighted routing reverted to previous pools.
harper (oncall): purging CF edge caches: `curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/<zone>/purge_cache" -d '{"purge_everything":true}'` (token in vault)
rui: opened AWS support case: SR-8675309, including query logs + change-id. CF ticket opened too.
amelia: customer-impact doc: "APAC customers experienced 5-10m of 502s/cert mismatches. Affected tenants: alpha-co, beta-app, gamma-inc." Draft posted to #customer-status.
karthik: monitoring: NXDOMAINs drop after rollback, cert-mismatch errors down but some resolvers still serving old IP for ~3-4 minutes (expected due to caching).
harper (oncall): good. quick runbook note for handover: if residual cache persists > 10m -> escalate to CF SRE to force revalidation on POP.
dan: logs: attaching sample dig output from a paris resolver vs singapore resolver:
```
; paris
;; ANSWER SECTION:
geodns.redwood.ai.  300 IN A 10.1.2.3
; singapore
;; ANSWER SECTION:
geodns.redwood.ai. 3600 IN A 52.23.45.67
```

shows old 3600 TTL still present in some caches.
amelia: support update sent to affected customers. template includes root cause (partial DNS propagation), mitigation (rollback + TTL reduction), and ETA for RCA.
harper (oncall): handoff in 10m to rui. Current status: recovering -> intermittent. Severity SEV2. Please keep channel updated with CF/AWS responses.
rui: taking over. Ill follow up on tickets and coordinate RCA.
ootcause-bot: PM assigned: amelia. Postmortem ETA: 72h. Suggested RCA focuses: rollout gating, TTL configuration, automated pre-checks for geo-policy updates.
harper (oncall): leaving a short checklist in the incident playbook:
- verify all recent DNS changes -> pause auto-rollouts
- set TTL low before any geo-policy changes
- add synthetic post-change checks in APAC/EU/NA
- ensure CF cache purge step in deployment pipeline

dan: noted. I'll add a safety guard to pause rollouts if healthchecks show >1% errors in 5m window.
deploy-bot: incident updated: status -> recovering at 02:22 PDT
harper (oncall): handing off. leaving channel. :white_check_mark:
